Fix .gitignore so web/dist/.gitkeep is actually tracked

The standalone `dist` line in .gitignore matched web/dist/ as a directory
exclusion, and once a directory is ignored you can't unignore individual
files inside it. CI's `go vet` therefore saw an empty web/dist and the
//go:embed all:dist directive failed before any other diagnostics could
run. Drop the broad `dist` rule — we already have explicit /dist-bin/
and /web/dist/* + !.gitkeep rules that cover what we actually want.

Atomic CAS for expired-lock reclaim

The previous read-check-delete-add reclaim path had a TOCTOU window: two
runners both observing the same expired lock could each delete it and then
race the unique-add — last writer wins, both think they hold the lock.

Replace with a $wpdb->update() compare-and-swap:

    UPDATE wp_postmeta
       SET meta_value = $new
     WHERE post_id  = $id
       AND meta_key = '_openclawp_lock'
       AND meta_value = $existing_raw

Only one concurrent runner sees rows
